The Jewish Exponent (27 June 2025): 'Rabbi Mendel Prus has been the head of the Chabad of Doylestown for a little less than 20 years'; 'We really started from scratch'; their first Rosh Hashanah drew 35 people; about a decade ago it ran a campaign for a new facility.
